title: Eddington luminosity
references: Rybicki, G. B. and Lightman, A. P., Radiative Processes in Astrophysics, Wiley (1979)
Frank, J., King, A. and Raine, D., Accretion Power in Astrophysics, 3rd ed., Cambridge University Press (2002)
CODATA 2022 recommended value of the Thomson cross section, https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?sigmae
validity_domain: Luminosity at which the outward radiation force on fully ionized hydrogen, by Thomson scattering on electrons, balances the inward gravitational force on the protons, for a steady, spherically symmetric flow around a mass M: L_Edd = 4 pi G M m_p c / sigma_T.
limitations: Holds under the stated geometry and composition only; non-spherical accretion, other opacities or non-steady flows can give luminosities above it. Without the assumption the engine gives no verdict (needs input), and a claim above the value is inconsistent with the limit only under the spherical, steady, ionized-hydrogen assumption
Thomson scattering only: other opacity sources change the value
Fully ionized hydrogen: a helium-rich composition has a different mass per electron
A bound of the model for a stable steady flow, not a limit of nature that no source can exceed
The mass is the mass of the central object in kg or g; no solar-mass unit is in the core units table
